![ytmgo in a terminal on Linux, and as a desktop app on Windows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anas1412/ytmgo/main/docs/public/ytmgo-apps.jpg)

**Linux** (the terminal app): `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anas1412/ytmgo/main/install.sh | bash`, or the `ytmgo_Linux_*.tar.gz` below.

**Windows** (the desktop app, beta): download `ytmgo-gui-setup.exe` below and run it. It installs for you alone, with no administrator prompt; yt-dlp comes with it, and ffmpeg is fetched the first time you download a song. The installer is not signed yet, so SmartScreen warns about an unknown publisher: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Each file's `.sha256` is beside it.

Something not working? https://github.com/anas1412/ytmgo/issues
